## Limitations and threats to validity

- The Fireworks-backed Claude Code observations are route-specific. A generic OpenAI-compatible translation layer can silently omit prior `reasoning_content` from later assistant tool turns, so those measurements do not represent a provider-native Anthropic integration or a bridge configured with explicit reasoning preservation [@pa1Issue102].
- The retained Claude Code observations also used a gateway deployment that mapped the requested `max` effort to `high`; the reasoning-history fix does not retroactively change those observations.
